posts.cooked:
These are sadly the worst kind of unlocks: at least with most of them you have story to work with, you can try to recreate the story events that led to that variant in the lore. But with these, that's not an option: the Freedom Five variants are a result of Oblivaeon destroying freedom tower and wrecking the freedom five. You can't do that, because Obliveaon isn't out yet. So now it's just a scavenger hunt, screwing around trying random things with no real direction or clues, hoping someone will find it by accident.

I know why the developers don't just release the variant and why they let people try to unlock it, but this is isn't satisfying: this isn't a reward for playing well, it's a reward for getting lucky.

Okay, rant over, tried a game against Baron Blade with Legacy, Wraith, Bunker, and Tachyon on the Mobile Defense Platform. These variants are essentially a celebration of the freedom five after all, so I thought I'd try recreating the Freedom Four Annual that started the team. No unlock. Running out of ideas fast (in fact that was pretty much my last idea, I've tried everything else that makes sense).
